scenes.title: The wish for one hour — and the west wind
The changing eyes; the lip, the foot, the hand
Beginning and end joined; content and form

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-go.title: blossom falling
the mild west wind — the gentle force of loss
the shade just enjoyed — autumn already seen within it
the fruit — ripening and germination overlapping
the valley — addressed as one's own, changed by every rain
the river — the swimmer never in the same water twice
walls and palaces — rock-solid, seen with changing eyes
the cliff — the foot's remembered daring, the chamois's boldness
lip · foot · hand — the articulated bodily form declared changed
beginning and end drawn together — faster than objects flee
the Muses — favour promising something imperishable; thanks asked
der Gehalt im Busen — the content borne inwardly
die Form im Geist — the formed expression carrying the relation onward
